title: A Inventory for the Silence
author: Juniper Ravensworth
blurb: Xanthe Halloran, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, has spent five years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
